question: Add the term smtp to the interface vocabulary (properties.interface.items.enum in scripts/dossier/schema.json), for a sender or mailbox host with an SMTP submission or relay endpoint?
why: AGENTS.md section 2 rule 12 adds a term when none fits. 19 email records mention SMTP in interface_detail; their interface is rest (11), rest and cli (3), webdav (3: fastmail, mailo, purelymail) or unknown (2: mailbig, and tuta, which states it offers no SMTP). email/elastic-email, email/maileroo and email/mailpace each answered a 220 banner on port 587 and keep rest, with SMTP named in interface_detail. Queue items 20261030-1251-expand-email-f2dd-u01-q01 and 20261030-1251-expand-email-f2dd-u04-q01 ask for the same term, with imap and pop3. Once the term exists, the interface of these records gains smtp.
